findings: NNS_G2dLoadPalette passes pSrcData->szByte and supplied address to DoLoadingPalette_ (g2d_Image.c:365-376). Nonextended main OBJ sends exact bytes to GX_LoadOBJPltt (180-207).
NNS_G2dLoadPaletteEx uses 32 bytes per PLTT16 palette and indexed offsets from PCMP (219-250); not a generic bounds clamp.

GX_LoadOBJPltt and GXS_LoadOBJPltt assert offset+szByte <= respective hardware OBJ palette size and even alignment, then DMA-copy requested bytes (gx_load2d.c:30-47). No clamp shown; assertion behavior depends on build configuration.

If unpacked shared palette size is 512 bytes, PC base offsets 64 and 192 would produce end offsets 576 and 704 against standard 512-byte OBJ palette capacity. This is a conditional risk, not observed runtime overflow; exact SDK unpacked palette size and compiled NCLR still unverified.
No currently verified free native slots. Experimental PC windows show that simply using five unknown slots cannot support full boxes even if all five become available.

environment.notes: Pinned upstream INSTALL and meson build require additional tools/dependencies; no installation, purchases or external private-source transfer attempted. Previous network restriction not retested in this release.
